en.name: John XV
en.summary: A pope whose reign, initially dominated by the Crescentii family, saw him canonize a saint by formal papal process for the first time.
en.body: John XV's papacy began under the heavy influence of the Roman noble Crescentius the Younger, though John later appealed successfully to the German court for support against this domination. He carried out the canonization of Bishop Ulrich of Augsburg in 993, the earliest surviving record of a saint formally canonized through papal proclamation rather than solely local acclaim.
